name: equiv_iff
statement: Σˣ f} {i : ι} (hx : x.1 ≤ i) (hy : y.1 ≤ i) : x ≈ y ↔ (f x.1 i hx) x.2 = (f y.1 i hy) y.2

name: equiv_lift
statement: ∀ i j hij x, g j (f i j hij x) = f' i j hij (g i x)) : DirectLimit G f ≃[L] DirectLimit G' f'

name: Equiv_iSup
statement: DirectLimit (fun i ↦ S i) (fun _ _ h ↦ Substructure.inclusion (S.monotone h)) ≃[L] (iSup S : L.Substructure M)

have_tree.name: liftInclusion_in_sup
have_tree.type: ∀ x, liftInclusion S x ∈ (⨆ i, S i)
